items.title: Live: Taylor confirms leadership challenge as prominent Liberals desert Ley
items.description: Angus Taylor has confirmed in a social media video he will challenge Sussan Ley for the Liberal leadership. Follow live.

items.title: PM 'not contemplating failure' as Closing the Gap deadline looms
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is bullish on closing the gap between Indigenous and non-Indigenous people ahead of handing down his annual report card on the progress made.

items.title: Floodwater leaves Alice Springs residents stranded
items.description: Northern Territory emergency services are working to rescue a number of people isolated by flooding, including a woman clinging to a tree in the middle of a river.

items.title: Muslim leader calls for public apology over police 'manhandling' of worshippers
items.description: Lebanese Muslim Association secretary Gamel Kheir says the community's relationship with police could be fractured following a Sydney protest, despite spending "nearly 20 years repairing" the damage caused by the Cronulla Riot.

items.title: Live: Michele Bullock faces Senate estimates, ASX rises
items.description: Australian stocks have opened higher, with major companies, including ANZ, Origin Energy, AMP and Temple & Webster, releasing earnings results today. Follow the latest updates in our live blog.

items.title: Australia's frozen ghost town leaves behind a toxic legacy
items.description: The ABC has been given rare access to an abandoned Australian base in Antarctica that continues to pose a threat to the environment.

items.title: Epstein files hearing descends into shouting matches
items.description: US Attorney-General Pam Bondi faces furious questions over the censorship of names in the Epstein files at a heated hearing before a committee of Congress.

items.title: The soccer club, the influencer and the fight to save a beloved West Bank institution
items.description: A campaign to save a West Bank football pitch from demolition has gone global. The sport's most powerful bodies, as well as social media influencers, have intervened to pressure Israeli authorities to reconsider its destruction.

items.title: Protesters, police gather as Herzog's Melbourne visit gets underway
items.description: Police are expecting thousands of people to gather in Melbourne's CBD again today to protest against Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit.

items.title: James Van Der Beek, star of Dawson's Creek, dies aged 48
items.description: The American actor was best known for his starring role as Dawson Leery in Dawson's Creek from 1998 to 2003.

items.title: Days before thousands of people crossed a new bridge, a 'large crack' was found
items.description: Days before the official opening, the Tasmanian government's largest-ever infrastructure project hit a hurdle, with a large crack picked up in one of the Bridgewater Bridge's piers detected and fixed, documents show.

items.title: FBI combs desert terrain for clues in Nancy Guthrie's disappearance
items.description: The man detained for questioning in the investigation into the disappearance of a US TV show host's mother has been released and the search continues.

items.title: Greens call for probe into decision to hold police funeral for paedophile cop
items.description: The Greens will push for Tasmania's parliament to scrutinise how police handled child abuse allegations against former officer Paul Reynolds, and why it was decided to give him a full police funeral.

items.title: 'This is over for me, I'm done': Woman says man assaulted her on solo bush hike
items.description: A woman's solo hike through regional Victoria took a disturbing turn near Daylesford, raising questions about safety and police responses.

items.title: An online order brought a paedophile and his depraved plan undone
items.description: "A regular sort of bloke" is how one of Jason Forbes's neighbours described the 39-year-old electrician — but behind the walls of his unassuming home in Perth's suburbs, he was hiding a dark secret.

items.title: Canadian school shooter identified as 18-year-old Jesse Van Rootselaar
items.description: Police identify the person who carried out a school massacre in a remote Canadian community as an 18-year-old woman with mental health issues.

items.title: Baker Boy on racism, mud crab and reshaping his positive persona
items.description: The Yolŋu artist known as the Fresh Prince of Arnhem Land is the king of feel-good bilingual bangers. But heavy is the crown.

items.title: Jakara Anthony's response to defeat should make us all proud
items.description: Disaster stared Jakara Anthony in the face and meted out the cruellest of injustices as she missed out on a moguls medal at the 2026 Winter Olympic Games. But her response showed us the character that should make Australia proud regardless.

items.title: Queensland MP admits he was naive to toe LNP line on abortion debate
items.description: Mackay MP Nigel Dalton crossed the floor on Tuesday to vote with Katter's Australian Party to end a parliamentary ban on abortion debate.

items.title: Case of rapist Broome publican highlights dangers facing town's vulnerable workforce
items.description: Temporary migrants reliant on visas are at high risk of workplace harassment, according to the Migrant Justice Institute.

items.title: A look at Iran's non-negotiable ballistic missile program
items.description: Iran has spent decades building the largest and most diverse ballistic missile stockpile in the Middle East and is refusing US demands to put limits on the weapons program.

items.title: Charges over 'shocking' abuse of puppy take a year, as RSPCA prosecutions drop
items.description: A man has been charged with animal cruelty a year after neighbours first made a complaint to the RSPCA.

items.title: The bikies and violent criminals allegedly linked to CFMEU corruption
items.description: Members of bikie gangs, convicted murderers and violent criminals are among more than 25 people who allegedly benefited from or are linked to corrupt behaviour at the CFMEU, according to a report.

items.title: WA set for 'carer cliff' as support services struggle under surging demand
items.description: An organisation that helps people caring for vulnerable family members in WA is experiencing unprecedented demand, with services unable to keep up with the community's needs.

items.title: South Africa beats Afghanistan after chaotic World Cup double super over
items.description: South Africa wins the most dramatic T20 World Cup group stage clash with Afghanistan, featuring two super overs and countless twists of fortune.
